Advanced ATC

Hochfrequenz-Datenlink

A long-range communication system enabling digital message exchange between aircraft and ground stations via high-frequency (HF) radio bands, often used for ATC datalink in oceanic and remote airspace (ICAO Doc 10037).

Definition

A long-range communication system enabling digital message exchange between aircraft and ground stations via high-frequency (HF) radio bands, often used for ATC datalink in oceanic and remote airspace (ICAO Doc 10037).

Operational example

Use the High-Frequency Data Link as primary datalink when VHF and SATCOM coverage is unavailable.

Localized term
